context_for_next_testing_agent: Video/Commercial feature fully working. Backend CRUD endpoints all pass. Frontend Videos tab UI works - can create video entries, see them in list with all action buttons. VideoSlide component integrated in lobby display rotation. Note: To test actual video playback in lobby, need to upload a real video file via the Upload button (Cloudinary rejects minimal test files). The active_only filter requires video_url to be non-empty, so videos without uploaded files won't appear in lobby rotation.

video_crud.create: POST /api/videos - creates entry with all fields
video_crud.read: GET /api/videos - returns all videos, GET /api/videos?active_only=true - filters
video_crud.delete: DELETE /api/videos/{id} - deletes and cleans up Cloudinary assets

video_upload.video_file: POST /api/videos/{id}/upload - uploads to Cloudinary hotel_lobby/videos folder
video_upload.thumbnail: POST /api/videos/{id}/thumbnail - uploads to Cloudinary hotel_lobby/video_thumbnails folder
